Features and moving averages strictly computed on completed past bars without lookahead. Walk-forward folds enforce strict 72-hour (864 bars) non-overlapping embargoes.

4_strategy_reproducibility.quantitative_evidence: Independent execution replay reproduces canonical trade counts and financial metrics with 0.00 discrepancy across all 9 strategies from deterministic decision logic. Zero reliance on external APIs, stochastic seeds, or undocumented heuristics.

5_statistical_predictive_advantage.quantitative_evidence: Multi-horizon historical analogues demonstrated conditional probability skew in Sprint 11.09. Strategy F lost -3.11% (-$311.08). Buy-and-Hold delivered +29.26% (+$2,926.43). USDT Cash delivered 0.00%. Zero active trading strategies achieved positive economic profit on the holdout partition.

7_robustness_across_market_regimes.quantitative_evidence: In chronological walk-forward validation across 3 strictly embargoed folds: Fold 1 (Bear Expansion): -5.80% net return (BNH -19.44%). Fold 2 (Consolidation Base): -21.54% net return (BNH -10.51%). Fold 3 (Bull Breakout): -5.72% net return (BNH +29.26%). The strategy failed to achieve positive net return in ANY of the three regimes.

synthesis.summary: The CBE research platform has achieved robust accounting correctness, dataset integrity, temporal causality, and 100% deterministic reproducibility. However, active behavioral analogue trading fails economic profitability (-5.72%) and multi-regime robustness. No predictive alpha is claimed based on accounting verification.
